svg.title: Proposed — Design Studio product and packaging station
svg.desc: Packaging content-type: three-face box preview with the operator's own front artwork mapped, camera presets, a dieline with bleed and safe marked, and a print-readiness checklist.

svg.text: Product and packaging station — concepts, mockups, dielines, insert cards and manufacturer-ready specs. Geometry is honest: a real mesh with the operator's own art mapped per face, never a photoreal render.
Formats, templates, compliance rules and brief fields are all derived from this one choice.

svg.text: Honest geometry: a real mesh shaded with a three-point rig. It is not a photoreal render and is never labelled as one.
cut, fold, bleed, safe all marked
Dieline complete · CMYK PDF/X-1a · bleed and safe marked · one open item: flatten transparency before export

Render 06 — PROPOSED: Product & packaging station. The 3D renderer already exists and is dependency-free (northstar-os-ui/src/studio/engine/three.js, a real mesh with painter's algorithm on a Canvas 2D context, no WebGL and no three.js). What is NEW: the print-spec export and the manufacturer handoff checklist.
